chapter: Childhood and first bands in Ohio
title: Hearing great concert artists as a child
summary: His mother took him to hear Paderewski, Kreisler, Caruso and other concert artists at Memorial Hall.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. My mother used to take me to hear all the artists when they would come home. I heard Paderewski in person.
What kind of auditorium did you have to hear?
Yeah, we called it Memorial Hall where they had all the concerts. I heard Fritz Kreisler in
person. I heard Caruso when I was six years old.
I heard Schumann-Heink. I heard Galli-Curci, Alma Gluck. My mother used to take me to hear all these people, you see.
